prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-bigN-39
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): f8860c97cece0805
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
TRAP: cpu trap asserted with tohost FAIL 0xdead on 256-word NOP (ADDI x0,x0,0, funct3==000) stream, expected instr_addi asserted. picorv32.v:1057 uses `!= 3'b000` so ADDI never decodes and overlaps other ALU-imm decodes. CONE_SLICE only resolves picosoc/picosoc.v:146 cpu instantiation with no decoder refs, so trace+excerpt win.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash f8860c97cece0805 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
